definition_zh: 本文中由轮轨相互作用力激励的强迫振动单元形式。
definition_en: The wheel–rail coupling formulation represented as a system excited by wheel–rail interaction forces in the cited study.
usage_overview: 用于列车—轨道动力建模，通过轮轨相互作用力连接车辆与轨道的响应，将两者之间的动力耦合纳入单元的强迫振动表述。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: In the wheel-rail contact element, the representation of wheel-rail interaction is transformed from the interaction force form, i.e., the wheel-rail interaction element, into the spring-dashpot element form, i.e., the wheel-rail contact element.
Extensively, a three-dimensional wheel-rail interaction element [24] is further developed.
